_doc: gh-2060 storage-surface ledger. Every browser-storage key the shipped source reads or writes must appear here with a status. tests/gh2060-storage-surface-ledger.mjs (a) rediscovers the keys from source and fails on any key missing from this file, (b) checks every citation (file exists and contains the quoted test name), (c) proves 'write-only' surfaces really have no reader. Statuses: tested = at least one test seeds stale/pre-existing state and asserts the correct behaviour; known-gap = a test encodes the RECOMMENDED DEFAULT and is expected to fail today (it.fails / knownGap), pending the Q: comment on #2060; write-only = no code path reads the value, so a stale copy is inert (the ledger test fails the moment a reader appears); excluded = not a browser storage key or intentionally long-lived (reason given).

start.html reuses sessionStorage.oq_router_lead_id to resubmit an existing lead via update_lead_contact (per-tab, no owner/timestamp). A reused tab lets the next visitor's Step-1 resubmit target the previous visitor's lead id; the server-side 30-minute / prefill_used_at guard is the only protection. No executable test exists yet: the resubmit path is a large closure in start.html that needs its own extraction harness. Q on #2060 with a recommended default.
